desc: Disprove the prior buffer-vertex/replacement-path characterization and discard it.
Replace it with the two internally vertex-disjoint, edge-distinct S-T paths characterization and a two-unit vertex-capacitated min-cost-flow solver.
Run the supplied sample tests (all 3 passed).
Exhaustively validate the characterization against configuration-space BFS on connected graphs up to six vertices and all ordered distinct S,T.
Harden residual shortest-path/potential handling and revalidate the implementation after the change.
Provide the final solver with proof and complexity justification.
